```{r}
rm(list=ls())
set.seed(42)
library(missRanger)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(UpSetR)
library(purrr)
library(conflicted)
library(VennDiagram)
library(grid)
library(eulerr)
conflicts_prefer(UpSetR::upset)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
```

```{r}
source("medication-lmer-utility.R")
source("plots.R")
```

```{r}
med_cols <- c("ACEi","ARB","BetaBlk","CCB","Diuretic","Metformin","Statin")
med_cols_rename <-c("ACEi","ARBs","β-Blocker","CCBs","Diuretics","Statins","Metformin")
disease_cols <- c('CVD', 'Endocrine', 'Psychiatric')
```

```{r}
AIBL_full_df_consist <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/AIBL/AIBL_cdr_imputed_binary_consist.csv")
colnames(AIBL_full_df_consist)[colnames(AIBL_full_df_consist) %in% med_cols] <- med_cols_rename
NACC_full_df_consist <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/NACC/NACC_cdr_imputed_binary_consist.csv")
colnames(NACC_full_df_consist)[colnames(NACC_full_df_consist) %in% med_cols] <- med_cols_rename
HABS_full_df_consist <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/HABSHD/HABSHD_cdr_imputed_binary_consist.csv")
colnames(HABS_full_df_consist)[colnames(HABS_full_df_consist) %in% med_cols] <- med_cols_rename
meta_full_df_consist <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/meta/meta_analysis_cdr_imputed_binary_consist.csv")
colnames(meta_full_df_consist)[colnames(meta_full_df_consist) %in% med_cols] <- med_cols_rename
```

# upset plot (Figure 1A & Figure S1)
## meta analysis
```{r}
meta_df_upset <- collapse_longitudinal(meta_full_df_consist, med_cols_rename)
png(file="../plots/upsetplot/meta_overall_cdr_upset.png", 
    width = 12000, height = 8000, res = 1200, units = "px")

upset(meta_df_upset, sets = rev(med_cols_rename), 
      # keep.order = TRUE,
      queries = list(
        list(query = elements,
             params = list("dataset", c("NACC", "AIBL","HABS")), color = "#DAA87C", active = T, query.name = "NACC"),
        list(query = elements,
             params = list("dataset", c("AIBL","HABS")), color = "#92A5D1", active = T, query.name = "AIBL"),
        list(query = elements,
             params = list("dataset", "HABS"), color = "#C9DCC4", active = T, query.name = "HABS-HD")),
      query.legend = "bottom",
      nintersects = 30, 
      order.by = "freq",
      empty.intersections = "on",
      mb.ratio = c(0.65, 0.35), point.size = 1, line.size = 0.3)

dev.off()
```

# Venn Diagram (Figure 1B)
```{r}
aibl_venn <- get_baseline(AIBL_full_df_consist)
nacc_venn <- get_baseline(NACC_full_df_consist)
habs_venn <- get_baseline(HABS_full_df_consist)
```

```{r}
aibl_sets  <- get_sets(aibl_venn)
nacc_sets  <- get_sets(nacc_venn)
habs_sets  <- get_sets(habs_venn)

aibl_p <- prefix_sets(aibl_sets, "AIBL")
nacc_p  <- prefix_sets(nacc_sets,  "NACC")
habs_p  <- prefix_sets(habs_sets,  "HABS")

total_sets <- list(
  CVD         = union(union(aibl_p$CVD,         nacc_p$CVD),         habs_p$CVD),
  Endocrine   = union(union(aibl_p$Endocrine,   nacc_p$Endocrine),   habs_p$Endocrine),
  Psychiatric = union(union(aibl_p$Psychiatric, nacc_p$Psychiatric), habs_p$Psychiatric)
)

total_rc <- region_counts(total_sets)
aibl_rc  <- region_counts(aibl_sets)
nacc_rc  <- region_counts(nacc_sets)
habs_rc  <- region_counts(habs_sets)

# ── 3. Draw fully manual symmetric Venn ───────────────────────────────────────
png("../plots/venn/comorbidity_venn_baseline.png",
    width = 14000, height = 14000, res = 1200, units = "px")

grid.newpage()
grid.rect(gp = gpar(fill = "white", col = NA))

# ── Circle geometry (all equal radius, classic 3-circle layout) ───────────────
r  <- 0.30          # circle radius in npc
cx <- c(0.38, 0.62, 0.50)   # centre x: CVD (left), Endocrine (right), Psychiatric (top)
cy <- c(0.38, 0.38, 0.62)   # centre y

fill_cols   <- c("#E07B6A", "#6AAED6", "#8DBF8A")
border_cols <- c("#C0392B", "#2471A3", "#1E8449")
cat_names   <- c("CVD", "Endocrine", "Psychiatric")

# Draw filled circles (back to front for overlap)
for (i in 1:3) {
  grid.circle(x  = cx[i], y = cy[i], r = r,
              gp = gpar(fill = adjustcolor(fill_cols[i], alpha.f = 0.40),
                        col  = border_cols[i], lwd = 6))
}

# ── Category labels (outside circles) ────────────────────────────────────────
# CVD — bottom left
grid.text("CVD",        x = 0.13, y = 0.28,
          gp = gpar(fontsize = 28, fontface = "bold", col = border_cols[1]))
# Endocrine — bottom right
grid.text("Endocrine",  x = 0.87, y = 0.28,
          gp = gpar(fontsize = 28, fontface = "bold", col = border_cols[2]))
# Psychiatric — top centre
grid.text("Psychiatric", x = 0.50, y = 0.95,
          gp = gpar(fontsize = 28, fontface = "bold", col = border_cols[3]))

# ── Helper to place a two-line label ─────────────────────────────────────────
place_label <- function(key, x, y, total_rc, aibl_rc, nacc_rc, habs_rc) {
  total  <- total_rc[[key]]
  cohort <- sprintf("(AIBL=%d, NACC=%d, HABS-HD=%d)",
                    aibl_rc[[key]], nacc_rc[[key]], habs_rc[[key]])
  # Total: large bold
  grid.text(as.character(total), x = x, y = y + 0.022,
            gp = gpar(fontsize = 22, fontface = "bold", col = "black"))
  # Cohort breakdown: small plain
  grid.text(cohort, x = x, y = y - 0.018,
            gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "plain", col = "grey15"))
}

# ── Region label positions (tuned for symmetric equal-circle layout) ──────────
#              key           x      y
place_label("CVD",        0.26,  0.38, total_rc, aibl_rc, nacc_rc, habs_rc)
place_label("Endo",       0.74,  0.38, total_rc, aibl_rc, nacc_rc, habs_rc)
place_label("Psych",      0.50,  0.75, total_rc, aibl_rc, nacc_rc, habs_rc)
place_label("CVD_Endo",   0.50,  0.30, total_rc, aibl_rc, nacc_rc, habs_rc)
place_label("CVD_Psych",  0.35,  0.54, total_rc, aibl_rc, nacc_rc, habs_rc)
place_label("Endo_Psych", 0.65,  0.54, total_rc, aibl_rc, nacc_rc, habs_rc)
place_label("All",        0.50,  0.46, total_rc, aibl_rc, nacc_rc, habs_rc)

# ── Title & subtitle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
grid.text("Comorbidity Overlap at Baseline",
          x = 0.50, y = 0.985,
          gp = gpar(fontsize = 30, fontface = "bold"))

grid.text(
  sprintf("AIBL (n=%d)   NACC (n=%d)   HABS-HD (n=%d)",
          nrow(aibl_venn), nrow(nacc_venn), nrow(habs_venn)),
  x = 0.50, y = 0.955,
  gp = gpar(fontsize = 20, col = "grey40"))

dev.off()
message("Saved: ../plots/venn/comorbidity_venn_baseline.png")
```


# Sankey plot (Figure 1C)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)
library(conflicted)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)

aibl_sankey <- get_baseline(AIBL_full_df_consist)
nacc_sankey <- get_baseline(NACC_full_df_consist)
habs_sankey <- get_baseline(HABS_full_df_consist)

disease_cols <- c("CVD", "Endocrine", "Psychiatric")
med_cols_use <- med_cols_rename  # c("ACEi","ARBs","β-Blocker","CCBs","Diuretics","Statins","Metformin")

# ── 2. Colours ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
disease_colors <- c(
  "CVD"         = "#928a9d",
  "Endocrine"   = "#ccbfde",
  "Psychiatric" = "#f3c9ca"
)

med_colors <- c(
  "ACEi"      = "#D4A5A5",
  "ARBs"      = "#C0392B",
  "β-Blocker" = "#E8A87C",
  "CCBs"      = "#F4D03F",
  "Diuretics" = "#A569BD",
  "Statins"   = "#5DADE2",
  "Metformin" = "#48C9B0"
)

# ── 3. Long format builder ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
build_sankey_long <- function(df, cohort_name) {
  df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols      = all_of(disease_cols),
                 names_to  = "disease",
                 values_to = "has_disease") %>%
    filter(has_disease == 1) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols      = all_of(med_cols_use),
                 names_to  = "medication",
                 values_to = "takes_med") %>%
    filter(takes_med == 1) %>%
    count(disease, medication, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(cohort = cohort_name)
}

aibl_long <- build_sankey_long(aibl_sankey, "AIBL")
nacc_long  <- build_sankey_long(nacc_sankey,  "NACC")
habs_long  <- build_sankey_long(habs_sankey,  "HABS-HD")

# ── 4. Draw function ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw_sankey <- function(long_df, cohort_name, n_total, color_by, outpath) {
  # color_by: "disease" or "medication"

  long_df <- long_df %>%
    mutate(
      disease    = factor(disease,    levels = c("CVD", "Endocrine", "Psychiatric")),
      medication = factor(medication, levels = med_cols_use)
    )

  if (color_by == "disease") {
    fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(values = disease_colors, name = "Comorbidity")
    fill_aes   <- aes(fill = disease)
  } else {
    fill_scale <- scale_fill_manual(values = med_colors, name = "Medication")
    fill_aes   <- aes(fill = medication)
  }

  p <- ggplot(long_df,
              aes(axis1 = disease,
                  axis2 = medication,
                  y     = n)) +
    geom_alluvium(fill_aes,
                  width = 1/6, alpha = 0.75, knot.pos = 0.4) +
    geom_stratum(width     = 1/6,
                 fill      = "grey93",
                 color     = "grey55",
                 linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_text(stat     = "stratum",
              aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
              size      = 4.2,
              fontface  = "bold",
              color     = "grey20") +
    fill_scale +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Comorbidity", "Medication"),
                     expand = c(0.12, 0.12)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.02, 0.02)) +
    labs(
      title    = sprintf("Comorbidity → Medication at Baseline — %s", cohort_name),
      subtitle = sprintf("n = %d participants at baseline", n_total),
      y        = "Number of participants"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey45"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", color = "grey20"),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 12)
    )

  ggsave(outpath,
         plot   = p,
         width  = 12,
         height = 9,
         dpi    = 1200,
         units  = "in",
         bg     = "white")

  message("Saved: ", outpath)
}

# ── 5. Call per cohort — coloured by disease ──────────────────────────────────
draw_sankey(aibl_long, "AIBL",    nrow(aibl_sankey),
            color_by = "disease",
            outpath  = "../plots/sankey/AIBL_sankey.png")

draw_sankey(nacc_long,  "NACC",    nrow(nacc_sankey),
            color_by = "disease",
            outpath  = "../plots/sankey/NACC_sankey.png")

draw_sankey(habs_long,  "HABS-HD", nrow(habs_sankey),
            color_by = "disease",
            outpath  = "../plots/sankey/HABS_sankey.png")

# ── Optional: rerun coloured by medication instead ───────────────────────────
# draw_sankey(aibl_long, "AIBL", nrow(aibl_sankey),
#             color_by = "medication",
#             outpath  = "../plots/sankey/AIBL_sankey_medcolor.png")
```











new version
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggalluvial)
library(conflicted)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)

aibl_sankey <- get_baseline(AIBL_full_df_consist)
nacc_sankey <- get_baseline(NACC_full_df_consist)
habs_sankey <- get_baseline(HABS_full_df_consist)

disease_cols <- c("CVD", "Endocrine", "Psychiatric")
med_cols <- c("ACEi", "ARBs", "β-Blocker", "CCBs", "Diuretics", "Statins", "Metformin")

disease_levels <- c("CVD", "Endocrine", "Psychiatric", "Comorbidity-free")
med_levels <- c("ACEi", "ARBs", "β-Blocker", "CCBs", "Diuretics", "Statins", "Metformin", "Non-user")

disease_colors <- c(
  "CVD" = "#928a9d",
  "Endocrine" = "#ccbfde",
  "Psychiatric" = "#f3c9ca",
  "Comorbidity-free" = "#D9D9D9"
)

build_sankey_long <- function(df, cohort_name) {
  
  tmp <- df %>%
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
    select(row_id, Disease_Control, Med_Control, all_of(disease_cols), all_of(med_cols))
  
  disease_long <- tmp %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(disease_cols),
      names_to = "disease",
      values_to = "has_disease"
    ) %>%
    filter(has_disease == 1) %>%
    select(row_id, disease) %>%
    bind_rows(
      tmp %>%
        filter(Disease_Control == 0) %>%
        transmute(row_id, disease = "Comorbidity-free")
    )
  
  med_long <- tmp %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(med_cols),
      names_to = "medication",
      values_to = "takes_med"
    ) %>%
    filter(takes_med == 1) %>%
    select(row_id, medication) %>%
    bind_rows(
      tmp %>%
        filter(Med_Control == 0) %>%
        transmute(row_id, medication = "Non-user")
    )
  
  disease_long %>%
    inner_join(med_long, by = "row_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    count(disease, medication, name = "n") %>%
    mutate(
      cohort = cohort_name,
      disease = factor(disease, levels = disease_levels),
      medication = factor(medication, levels = med_levels)
    )
}

draw_sankey <- function(long_df, source_df, cohort_name, outpath) {
  
  n_total <- nrow(source_df)
  
  p <- ggplot(
    long_df,
    aes(axis1 = disease, axis2 = medication, y = n)
  ) +
    geom_alluvium(
      aes(fill = disease),
      width = 1 / 6,
      alpha = 0.75,
      knot.pos = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_stratum(
      width = 1 / 6,
      fill = "grey93",
      color = "grey55",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_text(
      stat = "stratum",
      aes(
        label = case_when(
          after_stat(x) == 1 & after_stat(stratum) == "CVD" ~ sprintf("CVD\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$CVD == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$CVD == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
          after_stat(x) == 1 & after_stat(stratum) == "Endocrine" ~ sprintf("Endocrine\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$Endocrine == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$Endocrine == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
          after_stat(x) == 1 & after_stat(stratum) == "Psychiatric" ~ sprintf("Psychiatric\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$Psychiatric == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$Psychiatric == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
          # after_stat(x) == 1 & after_stat(stratum) == "Comorbidity-free" ~ sprintf("Comorbidity-free\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$Disease_Control == 0, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$Disease_Control == 0, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
        after_stat(x) == 1 & after_stat(stratum) == "Comorbidity-free" ~ sprintf("Comorbidity-free\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$Disease_Control == 0, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$Disease_Control == 0, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),          after_stat(x) == 2 & after_stat(stratum) == "ACEi" ~ sprintf("ACEi\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$ACEi == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$ACEi == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
          after_stat(x) == 2 & after_stat(stratum) == "ARBs" ~ sprintf("ARBs\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$ARBs == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$ARBs == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
          after_stat(x) == 2 & after_stat(stratum) == "β-Blocker" ~ sprintf("β-Blocker\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$`β-Blocker` == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$`β-Blocker` == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
          after_stat(x) == 2 & after_stat(stratum) == "CCBs" ~ sprintf("CCBs\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$CCBs == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$CCBs == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
          after_stat(x) == 2 & after_stat(stratum) == "Diuretics" ~ sprintf("Diuretics\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$Diuretics == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$Diuretics == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
          after_stat(x) == 2 & after_stat(stratum) == "Statins" ~ sprintf("Statins\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$Statins == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$Statins == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
          after_stat(x) == 2 & after_stat(stratum) == "Metformin" ~ sprintf("Metformin\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$Metformin == 1, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$Metformin == 1, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
          after_stat(x) == 2 & after_stat(stratum) == "Non-user" ~ sprintf("Non-user\nn=%d (%.1f%%)", sum(source_df$Med_Control == 0, na.rm = TRUE), 100 * sum(source_df$Med_Control == 0, na.rm = TRUE) / n_total),
          TRUE ~ as.character(after_stat(stratum))
        )
      ),
      size = 3.0,
      fontface = "bold",
      color = "grey20"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = disease_colors, name = "Comorbidity") +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits = c("Comorbidity", "Medication"),
      expand = c(0.12, 0.12)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("Comorbidity → Medication at Baseline — %s", cohort_name),
      subtitle = sprintf("n = %d participants at baseline", n_total),
      y = "Number of disease-medication links"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey45"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", color = "grey20"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  
  ggsave(outpath, plot = p, width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 900, units = "in", bg = "white")
  message("Saved: ", outpath)
}

aibl_long <- build_sankey_long(aibl_sankey, "AIBL")
nacc_long <- build_sankey_long(nacc_sankey, "NACC")
habs_long <- build_sankey_long(habs_sankey, "HABS-HD")

draw_sankey(aibl_long, aibl_sankey, "AIBL", "../plots/sankey/AIBL_sankey.png")
draw_sankey(nacc_long, nacc_sankey, "NACC", "../plots/sankey/NACC_sankey.png")
draw_sankey(habs_long, habs_sankey, "HABS-HD", "../plots/sankey/HABS_sankey.png")
```

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# PART 2 — DENSITY PLOTS (one file per group per cohort)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

med_cols <- c("ACEi", "ARBs", "β-Blocker", "CCBs", "Diuretics", "Statins", "Metformin")
disease_cols <- c("CVD", "Endocrine", "Psychiatric")

make_age_summary_table <- function(df, cohort_name) {
  bind_rows(
    df %>%
      pivot_longer(all_of(med_cols), names_to = "group", values_to = "yes") %>%
      filter(yes == 1) %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(type = "Medication"),
    
    df %>%
      filter(Med_Control == 0) %>%
      summarise(group = "Non-user", n = n(), mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(type = "Medication"),
    
    df %>%
      pivot_longer(all_of(disease_cols), names_to = "group", values_to = "yes") %>%
      filter(yes == 1) %>%
      group_by(group) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(type = "Comorbidity"),
    
    df %>%
      filter(Disease_Control == 0) %>%
      summarise(group = "Comorbidity-free", n = n(), mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE), sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      mutate(type = "Comorbidity")
  ) %>%
    mutate(cohort = cohort_name, mean_sd = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", mean_age, sd_age)) %>%
    select(cohort, type, group, n, mean_sd)
}

age_summary_table <- bind_rows(
  make_age_summary_table(aibl_sankey, "AIBL"),
  make_age_summary_table(nacc_sankey, "NACC"),
  make_age_summary_table(habs_sankey, "HABS-HD")
)

age_summary_table
```
